findings.issue: Token list is corrupted: tokens[0] もう and tokens[1] 一度 (all-null glosses) appear at the start, before 万一, out of sentence order; もう一度 already appears as a proper combined token in its correct position after the comma. Aligned display would show もう一度 twice.

findings.issue: In 電話をください, ください is the main verb (imperative of くださる 'give me') taking 電話を as its direct object — not an auxiliary. It is auxiliary only in 〜てください. The token's own note correctly calls it the imperative of くださる, contradicting the role label.
Final sentence 'O alvo é coverage de N4.' is leaked pipeline metadata with an untranslated English word ('coverage'); it names no grammar point and has no value for the learner.
findings.current: O alvo é coverage de N4.
findings.suggested: Remove the final sentence 'O alvo é coverage de N4.'

findings.issue: Final sentence 'The target is N4 coverage.' is leaked pipeline metadata; unlike other 'target' mentions in the corpus it names no grammar point and teaches nothing.
findings.suggested: Remove the final sentence 'The target is N4 coverage.'

findings.issue: 万事 means 'everything/all things'; 'Much depends' weakens the quantification and is inconsistent with lit_en ('Everything depends…'), pt ('Tudo depende…') and the token gloss 'everything'.
までに = 'até (no máximo)', including 6:00 itself; 'antes das 6' means strictly before 6 and contradicts the item's own expl_pt/lit_pt, which teach までに as 'até as 6 horas (no máximo)'.
findings.current: Todo dia eu volto para casa antes das 6 horas, viu?
findings.suggested: Todo dia eu volto para casa até as 6 horas, viu?
